title: 76-foot Rockefeller Center Christmas tree arrives in Manhattan
text:
76-foot Rockefeller Center Christmas tree arrives in Manhattan - ABC7 New York 
 24/7 Live New York City New Jersey Long Island Northern Suburbs Connecticut COMMUNITY & EVENTS 
 Rockefeller Center Christmas tree arrives in Manhattan 
 Saturday, November 7, 2026 12:09PM 
 The Rockefeller Center Christmas tree has arrived in Manhattan. The 76-foot Norway spruce traveled from West Edmeston, New York, under police escort and will be lit on Dec. 2. WABC The Rockefeller Center Christmas tree has officially arrived in New York City, marking another milestone in the start of the holiday season.
 The 76-foot Norway spruce made its way into Midtown Manhattan Friday night under a heavy police escort after being cut down earlier this week in Madison County, New York . The tree will now be prepared for its annual unveiling at Rockefeller Center, where it will stand through the holiday season.
 The spruce comes from West Edmeston, an upstate community about 70 miles southeast of Syracuse. The tree stands 76 feet tall, weighs approximately 11 tons and measures about 50 feet wide.
 The tree is scheduled to be illuminated during the annual Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Lighting ceremony on Dec. 2. It will be decorated with more than 50,000 energy-efficient LED lights and topped with the iconic Swarovski star.
 Visitors will be able to see the tree on display through mid-January before it is milled into lumber and donated to Habitat for Humanity, continuing a long-standing Rockefeller Center tradition.
